name: transitive-local-chain
source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { base } from '@meta/base';
import Component from './Component.vue';
const suffix = '-route';
const title = base + suffix;
function resolveTitle() { return title; }
definePageMeta({ title: resolveTitle(), middleware: resolveTitle });
</script>
<template><main>whole metadata consumer</main></template>
<style scoped>main { display: block; }</style>

name: closure-local-shadowing
source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { title } from '@meta/title';
import { input } from './UnusedInput';
const middleware = (input) => { const title = input.title; return title; };
definePageMeta({ title, middleware });
</script>
<template><main>whole metadata consumer</main></template>
<style scoped>main { display: block; }</style>
oracleShadowingLimit: Nuxt4.0.3 processDeclaration walks variable initializers by name and retains imported input despite a same-named arrow parameter; native resolved references omit it.

name: shared-diamond-dependencies
source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { first } from '@meta/first';
import { second } from '@meta/second';
const shared = first + second;
const left = shared + '-left';
const right = shared + '-right';
function middleware() { return left + right; }
definePageMeta({ title: right, middleware, alias: left });
</script>
<template><main>whole metadata consumer</main></template>
<style scoped>main { display: block; }</style>
